market_summary: USD and safe-haven flows dominate during the London/NY overlap. XAUUSD and BTCUSD exhibit severe trend expansions below their respective session Value Area Lows and VWAP baselines with matching bearish CVD order flow, offering clear momentum continuation setups. EURUSD and GBPUSD remain trapped in mid-range Value Area chop around VWAP/EMA50, while US100 displays a sharp wick rejection off session lows, warranting patience across FX and equities.

signals.rationale: VP context shows price trading well below VAL (3947.11) and POC (3978.35). CVD is strongly BEARISH (-8.31, slope -3.55), fully agreeing with aggressive sell-side pressure. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP with high liquidity. Trend is firmly bearish below VWAP (3960.92) and EMA50 (3952.99). Price is riding below the lower ATR band (3911.74) with expanding volatility and supported by recent RVOL yellow spikes (>2.0). The breakdown accepted cleanly below prior S/R at 3924.30, targeting the Session Low at 3884.62.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping vwap and ema50
signals.level_event: acceptance below support 3924.30 pushing toward session low

lucid_plan.sizing: fixed target 1.25 cannot reach $381 net at an allowed size; next structure Session Low at 5.6 gives $555 net with 1 GC (risk $1310)

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10801 to VAH 1.10976) and below POC (1.10928). CVD is NEUTRAL (+4,771 vs 117k volume), showing lack of directional conviction. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price sits right on VWAP (1.10861) and EMA50 (1.10884), drifting mid-channel between the ATR bands without momentum. While recent volume printed yellow RVOL spikes, price is trapped in a tight mean-reverting chop between Prev Low (1.10824) and Session High (1.11027). Awaiting clear breakout/expansion.

signals.level_event: rejection at session low and returning to poc

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593 to VAH 1.32778) and below POC (1.32738). Confluence checklist favors a neutral hold inside value.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral compressed between vwap and ema50

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (28081.85) and POC (28120.74). CVD is BEARISH (-3.27) but short-term slope has turned slightly positive (+0.83). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. While overall trend sits below VWAP (28121.69) and EMA50 (28130.78), the signal candle printed a major liquidity sweep and rejection of Session Low (27912.13) with a deep lower wick, closing back above lower ATR band and S/R 28030.00. Dukascopy US100 RVOL typically lacks yellow spikes, but the sharp intraday absorption and conflicting bounce warrant staying aside.
signals.level_event: rejection of session low with long lower wick

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (73260.85) and POC (73517.38) in a pronounced trend expansion. CVD is BEARISH (-0.07, slope -0.02) aligning with downward momentum. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Market is heavily suppressed below downward-sloping VWAP (73371.34) and EMA50 (73264.39). Price is hugging and breaking through the lower ATR band (72397.07) backed by strong RVOL (yellow spike 3 bars ago and sustained volume). S/R support at Prev Low 73097.30 was cleanly surrendered, opening continuation toward Session Low at 72155.80.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish steep sell-off below vwap and ema50
signals.level_event: acceptance below prev low continuing down
